arxiv-1509-07700.title: Numerical simulations of axisymmetric hydrodynamical Bondi-Hoyle accretion onto a compact object Numerical simulations of axisymmetric hydrodynamical Bondi-Hoyle accretion onto a compact object – References YEAR
arxiv-1509-07700.creator: I. El Mellah & F. Casse
arxiv-1509-07700.description: Abstract Bondi-Hoyle accretion configurations occur as soon as a gravitating body is immersed in an ambient medium with a supersonic relative velocity. From wind-accreting X-ray binaries to runaway neutron stars, such a regime has been witnessed many times and is believed to account for shock formation, the properties of which can be only marginally derived analytically.

arxiv-2201-09076.title: Learning Based Task Offloading in Digital Twin Empowered Internet of Vehicles
arxiv-2201-09076.creator: Jinkai Zheng, Tom H. Luan, Longxiang Gao, Yao Zhang, and Yuan Wu
arxiv-2201-09076.description: Abstract Mobile edge computing has become an effective and fundamental paradigm for futuristic autonomous vehicles to offload computing tasks. However, due to the high mobility of vehicles, the dynamics of the wireless conditions, and the uncertainty of the arrival computing tasks, it is difficult for a single vehicle to determine the optimal offloading strategy.

arxiv-2202-05286.title: The origin of the unfocused XMM-Newton background, its variability and lessons learned for ATHENA
arxiv-2202-05286.creator: Fabio Gastaldello, Martino Marelli, Silvano Molendi, Iacopo Bartalucci, Patrick Kühl, Catherine E. Grant, Simona Ghizzardi, Mariachiara Rossetti, Andrea De Luca, Andrea Tiengo
arxiv-2202-05286.description: Abstract We analyzed the unexposed to the sky ( outFOV ) region of the MOS2 detector on board XMM-Newton covering 15 years of data amounting to 255 Ms. We show convincing evidence that the origin of the unfocused background in XMM-Newton is due to energetic protons, electrons and hard X-ray photons.

arxiv-2205-05616.title: Local cohomology under small perturbations
arxiv-2205-05616.creator: Luís Duarte
arxiv-2205-05616.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Luís Duarte. Let ( R , 𝔪 ) (R,\mathfrak{m}) be a Noetherian local ring and I I an ideal of R R . We study how local cohomology modules with support in 𝔪 \mathfrak{m} change for small perturbations J J of I I , that is, for ideals J J such that I ≡ J mod 𝔪 N I\equiv J\bmod\mathfrak{m}^{N} for large N N , under the hypothesis that I I and J J share the same Hilbert function.

arxiv-2302-11354.title: Learning Dynamic Graph Embeddings with Neural Controlled Differential Equations
arxiv-2302-11354.creator: Tiexin Qin, Benjamin Walker, Terry Lyons, Hong Yan, Haoliang Li
arxiv-2302-11354.description: Abstract This paper focuses on representation learning for dynamic graphs with temporal interactions. A fundamental issue is that both the graph structure and the nodes own their own dynamics, and their blending induces intractable complexity in the temporal evolution over graphs.

arxiv-2408-10262.title: An Analysis of the Impact of Gold Open Access Publications in Computer Science
arxiv-2408-10262.creator: Pádraig Cunningham, Barry Smyth
arxiv-2408-10262.description: Abstract There has been some concern about the impact of predatory publishers on scientific research for some time. Recently, publishers that might previously have been considered ‘predatory’ have established their bona fides , at least to the extent that they are included in citation impact scores such as the field-weighted citation impact (FWCI).

arxiv-2408-17450.title: Signatures of polarized chiral spin disproportionation in rare earth nickelates
arxiv-2408-17450.creator: Jiarui Li, Robert J. Green, Claribel Domínguez, Abraham Levitan, Yi Tseng, Sara Catalano, Jennifer Fowlie, Ronny Sutarto, Fanny Rodolakis, Lucas Korol, Jessica L. McChesney, John W. Freeland, Dirk Van der Marel, Marta Gibert, Riccardo Comin
arxiv-2408-17450.description: Abstract In Rare earth nickelates (RENiO 3 ), electron-lattice coupling drives a concurrent metal-to-insulator and bond disproportionation phase transition whose microscopic origin has long been the subject of active debate. Of several proposed mechanisms, here we test the hypothesis that pairs of self-doped ligand holes spatially condense to provide local spin moments that are antiferromagnetically coupled to Ni spins.

arxiv-2601-08736.title: Note on High Dimensional Spatial-Sign Test for One Sample Problem
arxiv-2601-08736.creator: Ping Zhao
arxiv-2601-08736.description: Abstract We revisit the null distribution of the high-dimensional spatial-sign test of 6 under mild structural assumptions on the scatter matrix. We show that the standardized test statistic converges to a non-Gaussian limit, characterized as a mixture of a normal component and a weighted chi-square component.

europmc-pmc4233753.title: Mapping the stereotyped behaviour of freely moving fruit flies.
europmc-pmc4233753.creator: Berman GJ, Choi DM, Bialek W, Shaevitz JW.
europmc-pmc4233753.description: A frequent assumption in behavioural science is that most of an animal's activities can be described in terms of a small set of stereotyped motifs. Here, we introduce a method for mapping an animal's actions, relying only upon the underlying structure of postural movement data...

pmc-11632687.title: Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair of Common Atrioventricular Valve Regurgitation in the Setting of a Lateral Tunnel Fontan Circulation
pmc-11632687.creator: Rachael Cordina, Seshika Ratwatte, Lynn Khor, Brian Plunkett, Joanne Irons, David Baker, Ian Nicholson, Mark McGuire, Lisa Simmons, Martin Ng
pmc-11632687.description: Highlights•Percutaneous repair of severely regurgitant atrioventricular valves in the setting of a Fontan circulation utilizing Tri-Clip, even in the setting of an atrioventricular septal defect, is feasible.•Percutaneous options hold promise as a low-risk repair strategy in this highly complex population, which generally has a high surgical risk.

pmc-13041133.title: The chain mediation model of psychological resilience and social participation among stroke survivors with disability: the role of exercise adherence and physical disability
pmc-13041133.creator: Xuan Zhou, Ying Wang, Lanshu Zhou
pmc-13041133.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to examine the chain mediating roles of exercise adherence and physical disability in the relationship between psychological resilience and social participation among stroke survivors with disability.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted with 271 stroke survivors recruited from five rehabilitation departments in Shanghai between March and June 2025.

pmc-13185130.title: Photoisomerization of Isatogens to Benzoxazin-4-ones
pmc-13185130.creator: Sasirome Racochote, Chokratchanee Nutthawasutha, Usamah Bado, Chatphorn Theppitak, Jumreang Tummatorn, Somsak Ruchirawat, Charnsak Thongsornkleeb
pmc-13185130.description: A mild photoinduced isomerization of isatogens to benzoxazin-4-ones is described. Upon irradiation at 370 nm, a broad range of 2-aryl- and 2-alkyl-substituted isatogens undergo efficient scaffold reorganization under catalyst-free conditions to afford benzoxazin-4-ones in good to excellent yields. The transformation tolerates diverse substitution patterns, including heteroaryl and strained alkyl groups, and is readily scalable.

pmc-13264237.title: Extracellular vesicles subpopulation derived of clonal mesenchymal stem cells protected retinal ganglion cells in mouse model with optic nerve crush
pmc-13264237.creator: Leila Satarian, Nasim Eslami, Rezvaneh Saeedi-fard, Elham Yektadoost, Amir Shojaei, Fatemeh Sadat Hosseini Mazinani, Leila Taghiyar, Sara Poosti, Abdolreza Nazari, Fatemeh Zarei, Majid Halvaie, Faezeh Shekari
pmc-13264237.description: IntroductionRecent studies have shown that Mesenchymal stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles (MSC-EVs) have significant potential to protect retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) function. Here, EVs were obtained from various MSCs, including dental pulp MSCs, trabecular meshwork MSCs, and bone marrow-derived clonal MSCs (cMSCs).MethodsThe different fractions of EVs were separated by high-speed (20K) and ultra-speed (110K) centrifugation.
